control-height.$description: The shared interactive-control size scale, aligned to Beacon's UiSize. One ramp so inputs, buttons, selects and icon buttons line up on a row. Tier 3 narrows it per family (--form-height-* for form controls); re-point HERE to resize every control at once.

chip-height.$description: The size scale for non-interactive labels that sit inline with text — badges and pills. Smaller than a control at every step, and deliberately its own ramp: making controls taller should not make badges taller.
